conclusion: Under K2P and K3P, generic exact data from a displayed tree are compatible with every network displaying that tree.  In the explicit strong level-1 family on m+2 leaves, every open tree distribution has at least 2^m pairwise non-triangle-equivalent compatible topologies.

exponential_family.schema: start with the rooted labelled caterpillar on L0,...,L_(m+1); at site i independently retain its ordinary binary vertex or replace it by A_i->B_i, A_i->C_i, B_i->C_i with C_i reticulate

status.JC_open_displayed_tree_containment_by_un: PROVED ABSENT; uniform multiplier x=0 is excluded

construction: choose the parent retained in the displayed tree at each reticulation
put the uniform kernel on every unchosen incoming arc
replace each local parent mixture by p*T+(1-p)*U
factor every target tree-edge kernel into the required JC inheritance factors and strict network-edge kernels

local_uniformization.strict_positivity: if 0<p<1 and every r_h>0, then every p*r_h+(1-p)/4 is strictly positive

models.K2P: closed under convolution and contains every JC and uniform kernel
models.K3P: all strict group-based kernels; closed under convolution

theorem.statement: For M in {K2P,K3P}, every binary rooted network N and every displayed tree T satisfy M_T^M subseteq M_N^M on the complete open stochastic tree image.

relations.JC: open stochastic interiors disjoint by the prior strict invariant
relations.K2P: tree preceq cycle; dimensions 6<9; not bowtie
relations.K3P: tree preceq cycle; dimensions 9<14; not bowtie
